name: Taiko Juku
description: Taiko Juku — a taiko drumming school theme that scrolls like a vertical scroll: a sumi header with the school name and a Try a class button, whose menu runs down a fixed side rail on wide screens (top to bottom in Chinese and Japanese). Edo purple (#745399) is the main colour: the hero, every page head and the festival band are purple fields with white type. The hero is a framed window: a low-key photograph of a drummer in a dark timber dojo inside a deep sumi frame, with a cut-out drum breaking out of the window and over the hero edge; a second cut-out drum breaks over the class band. Every picture is a low-key photograph (50mm f/1.4, hard window light, dark ground, graded toward Edo purple). Yusei Magic for display, Karla for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical section labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-22 (tategaki-vertical-scroll, framed-window hero, side-rail nav, real-photography, low-key, Edo purple #745399, Yusei Magic + Karla). A full top header (school name, menu, Try a class button) whose menu runs down a fixed left side rail from 1100 px (stacked vertical words in Chinese and Japanese, overlay menu on small screens). Every section hangs its label on a narrow spine (vertical in Chinese and Japanese, horizontal in English, French and German). Every picture is a low-key photograph generated with Grok Build (50mm f/1.4, hard window light, dark ground, graded toward Edo purple); break-frame: a cut-out drum breaks out of the hero window frame and over the hero edge, and a second one breaks over the class band's top edge. Sample content in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de. Contrast: white #FFFFFF on Edo purple #745399 6.1:1 (all text on the hero, page heads and festival band); paper #F5F1F8 on Edo purple 5.5:1; sumi #17121F on paper #F5F1F8 16.5:1; deep purple #5B3F7E on paper 7.7:1 (links, labels); ash violet #544B5E on paper 7.4:1 (secondary text); lilac #C9B3E6 on sumi 9.7:1 (labels, times on the header, rail, board and class band); paper on sumi 16.5:1; white on sumi buttons 18.4:1; sumi on Edo purple only 3.0:1, never used for text.

summary.zh-TW: 江戶紫的太鼓教室：側欄直書選單、深框窗景的低調暗調攝影主視覺，去背太鼓衝出畫框；樣本內容含五種語言。
summary.en: An Edo-purple taiko school: a side-rail menu, a low-key photo in a deep window frame and a cut-out drum breaking out of it.
summary.ja: 江戸紫の和太鼓教室。サイドレールの縦書きメニュー、深い窓枠のローキー写真、枠を破る切り抜きの太鼓。五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Une école de taiko violet d’Edo : menu en rail latéral, photo sombre dans une fenêtre et tambour détouré qui en sort.
summary.de: Eine Taiko-Schule in Edo-Violett: Menü als Seitenleiste, Low-Key-Foto im tiefen Fensterrahmen, ein Trommel-Freisteller bricht heraus.
